it: \rOh, wow. Non avevo mai visto qualcuno che venisse da fuori.

id: \bHello there. Want my Abra to take you somewhere?
en: \bHello there. Want my Abra to take you somewhere?
it: \bSalve. Vuoi che il mio Abra ti porti da qualche parte?

id: \bIf you ever feel like it.
en: \bIf you ever feel like it.
it: \bQuando ne hai voglia.

id: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you. Which do you want to know about?
en: \bSo you want to know about Pokémon that used to evolve by trade? Let me break it down for you.  Which do you want to know about?
it: \bQuindi vuoi sapere dei Pokémon che un tempo si evolvevano tramite scambio? Te lo spiego io. Di quale vuoi sapere?

id: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, and Haunter evolve at level 35.
en: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler, and Haunter evolve at level 35.
it: \bKadabra, Machoke, Graveler e Haunter si evolvono al livello 35.

id: \bPoliwhirl and Slowpoke evolve in the day when holding a King's Rock. Onix at day with a Metal Coat. Porygon at day with an Upgrade.
en: \bPoliwhirl and Slowpoke evolve in the day when holding a King's Rock. Onix at day with a Metal Coat.  Porygon at day with an Upgrade.
it: \bPoliwhirl e Slowpoke si evolvono di giorno se tengono una Roccia di Re. Onix di giorno con una Metalcoperta. Porygon di giorno con un Upgrade.

id: \bClamperl at day with a Deep Sea Scale. Feebas at day with a Prism Scale.
en: \bClamperl at day with a Deep Sea Scale. Feebas at day with a Prism Scale.
it: \bClamperl di giorno con una Squamabissi. Feebas di giorno con una Squama Bella.

id: \bRhydon at day with a Protector. Magmar at day with a Magmarizer.
en: \bRhydon at day with a Protector. Magmar at day with a Magmarizer.
it: \bRhydon di giorno con un Copertura. Magmar di giorno con un Magmatore.

id: \bScyther evolves when holding a Metal Coat at night. Seadra at night with a Dragon Scale. Porygon2 at night with a Dubious Disk.
en: \bScyther evolves when holding a Metal Coat at night. Seadra at night with a Dragon Scale. Porygon2 at night with a Dubious Disk.
it: \bScyther si evolve di notte se tiene una Metalcoperta. Seadra di notte con una Squama Drago. Porygon2 di notte con un Dubbiodisco.

id: \bClamperl at night with a Deep Sea Tooth.
en: \bClamperl at night with a Deep Sea Tooth.
it: \bClamperl di notte con un Dente Abissi.

id: \bElectabuzz at night with an Electirizer. Dusclops at night with a Reaper Cloth.
en: \bElectabuzz at night with an Electirizer. Dusclops at night with a Reaper Cloth.
it: \bElectabuzz di notte con un Elettritore. Dusclops di notte con un Terrorpanno.

id: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
en: \bCome back again if you want to know more.
it: \bTorna pure se vuoi saperne di più.

id: \bBarry: \PN! You finally made it, though you're late! That almost deserves a fine.
en: \bBarry: \PN! You finally made it, though you're late!  That almost deserves a fine.
it: \bBarry: \PN! Finalmente sei arrivato, anche se in ritardo! Quasi quasi meriti una multa.

id: \bThere was a contest here to see who gets to battle the Tower Tycoon Palmer. He's also my dad.
en: \bThere was a contest here to see who gets to battle the Tower Tycoon Palmer. He's also my dad.
it: \bQui c'è stato un torneo per decidere chi avrebbe sfidato il Magnate Torre Palmer. Che poi è mio papà.

id: \bI was just about to fight him, but I suppose you deserve a chance. Don't expect to win though.
en: \bI was just about to fight him, but I suppose you deserve a chance. Don't expect to win though.
it: \bStavo proprio per affrontarlo, ma immagino che tu meriti una possibilità. Però non sperare di vincere.

id: \bBarry: I lost again? How am I ever going to catch up to you?
en: \bBarry: I lost again? How am I ever going to catch up to you?
it: \bBarry: Ho perso di nuovo? Come farò mai a raggiungerti?

en: \bI was going to battle my son, but it seems like you won the match. I hope you're ready for a fight.
